system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast as a Taijutsu Finisher. As part of the requirements of this jutsu, you must have at least the 5th Gate: Limit from the 8 Inner Gates: Seimon Taijutsu Feat.

The target of this jutsu must be Restrained or Grappled. Make five Taijutsu attacks against the target. On a hit, you deal [Unarmed Damage] + 1d12.

If all five attacks hit, you make a 6th attack. On a hit with the 6th attack, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage and knock the target Prone.
